data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'Gree', meaning 'strong' or 'vigorous'. In biblical lore, the name Greas or Greekos is attributed to several characters, including a Macedonian soldier in the New Testament and a son of Hezekiah mentioned in the Old Testament. The name Greeson carries the meaning “Strong, vigorous, or powerful” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Greeson usually hope their child will grow to embody strong, vigorous, or powerful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
